name: VIX spike cross-asset capitulation long (spot crypto)
rationale: VIX (equity implied volatility, via FRED, knowable next-day) is a BOUNDED, mean-reverting fear gauge for the WHOLE risk-asset complex. A VIX spike marks a cross-asset risk-off flush; crypto, as the highest-beta risk asset, tends to over-sell into these flushes and recover as volatility normalizes. This is genuinely ORTHOGONAL to crypto price/funding/sentiment — the trigger lives in the equity-vol market, not in crypto's own tape. Because VIX is bounded (typically ~12-80), a fitted spike threshold binds across the sample (not a drifting-level trap). Hypothesis: enter LONG spot crypto when VIX is in a spike band, hold until vol normalizes (signal exit) or risk limits hit. LOW-TURNOVER by construction (vol spikes are rare, holds span the normalization) so spot taker fees do not eat the edge. Disconfirmer 1 (orthogonality vs crypto's own vol): a crypto realized-volatility / oversold control is in the cohort — if it matches this spec, the equity VIX adds nothing beyond crypto's own panic. Disconfirmer 2 (cross-asset causality vs coincidence): the purged+embargoed holdout must stay positive; if VIX spikes merely COINCIDE with crypto bottoms in-sample but the relation breaks out-of-sample, the holdout DSR goes negative and the Gate kills it. An honest FAIL is valid — the deterministic Gate disposes.
catalyst: VIX enters a spike band (cross-asset risk-off flush)
